name: Iron Vanguard
intel: Heavy Shells now arrive early. They walk through weak fire — build Cannon near the bends.

name: Speeding Threat
intel: Runners mixed with normals. The narrow terrain limits your build options — make them count.

name: Armored Column
intel: Tank column. Cannon splash clears both simultaneously. Upgrade if available.

name: Fast and Heavy
intel: Mixed column. Tanks follow fast units — Slow + Cannon combination is optimal here.

name: Iron Route Finale
intel: Maximum pressure. Tanks absorb while fast units slip through gaps. No shortcuts.
